items.information: This competition will be held by Berkeley Cube Club in place of the normally scheduled Berkeley Winter 2020 competition. **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will **not** start more than 20 minutes before the scheduled time. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss the last call for that event. In general, the last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **Team Blind will be held unoficially** For further information, please refer to the "[Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSpeedcubin152019#8338-information)" tab.

items.name: PSKG Premiere Cubing 2020

venue.name: Penabur Secondary Kelapa Gading
venue.address: Jalan Boulevard Bukit Gading Raya Blok A5-A8 6, RT.6/RW.14, Klp. Gading Bar., Kec. Klp. Gading, Kota Jkt Utara, Daerah K

items.information: This will be the first speedcubing competition held in Penabur Secondary Kelapa Gading (PSKG), and will be held during the "**Premiere**" event. Visitors (non-competitor of speedcubing competition) of Premiere event will be charged Rp. 10.000 on saturday, which can be used to see other events besides the speedcubing competition on saturday. Competitors are allowed to bring one spectator in for free. On Sunday no fee will be charged because no other competitions will be held. Ini adalah kompetisi speedcubing pertama di Penabur Secondary Kelapa Gading (PSKG) dan akan diadakan pada saat acara "**Premiere**". Pengunjung (non-peserta kompetisi speedcubing) acara Premiere akan dikenakan biaya masuk sebesar Rp. 10.000 pada hari sabtu, yang bisa digunakan untuk melihat acara lain yang berlangsung selain kompetisi speedcubing pada hari perlombaan. Peserta dipersilakan untuk membawa satu penonton gratis. Pada hari minggu tidak akan dikenakan biaya karena tidak ada lomba lain yang berlangsung.
